business_problem: One Medical needed to reduce administrative burden on clinicians, support secure multimodal care across the United States, and give providers faster access to patient context while maintaining privacy and compliance.
solution_summary: One Medical built its primary-care technology platform on AWS so clinicians can spend less time on administration and more time with patients. At the center is 1Life, its purpose-built electronic health record system, which gives providers a single screen for charts, notes, medications, studies, and outside records across in-person and virtual care. The platform runs on AWS and supports secure messaging plus 24/7/365 on-demand video visits. On top of that foundation, One Medical uses HIPAA-compliant machine-learning services and Amazon Bedrock to automate document processing, explore patient-record summarization for providers, and recommend responses in telehealth messaging. Amazon SageMaker supports the broader ML environment surfaced in the case study. Together these services create a flexible, extensible care platform that shares patient context across clinics, reduces repetitive work, and lets One Medical add new services quickly as it scales.
